name: Coal LSL eligible wages method records (s 3B of the Payroll Levy Collection Act 1992)
advice_status: Not advice. Verify each provision against its primary source at the time of use.
notes: A record is served only while service_supported is true. Months before 2024-01 are not served: the engine implements the earlier casual method for the browser page, but the pre-amendment text of s 3B was not read in the session that wrote this file, so no record vouches for it.
The method was rechecked against Compilation No. 12 on 26 September 2026. The source check is not a practitioner attestation.

records.verified_by: Automated source retrieval and comparison; no professional review recorded
records.citation: Coal Mining Industry (Long Service Leave) Payroll Levy Collection Act 1992, s 3B, as amended by the Fair Work Legislation Amendment (Protecting Worker Entitlements) Act 2023 (No 43, 2023), Sch 6 items 12 to 17, commenced 1 January 2024. Read in Compilation No. 12 (C2026C00364, compilation date 1 September 2026).

source.title: Coal Mining Industry (Long Service Leave) Payroll Levy Collection Act 1992, Compilation No. 12
source.compilation: C2026C00364 (compilation date 1 September 2026, includes amendments up to Act No. 63, 2026)

provisions.base_rate: s 3B(1): greater of (a) base rate of pay including incentive-based payments and bonuses, and (b) 75% of the base rate of pay including incentive-based payments and bonuses, overtime or penalty rates, and allowances other than those for reimbursement of expenses.
provisions.annual_salary: s 3B(2): annual salary paid including incentive-based payments and bonuses, excluding overtime or penalty rates and shift-loadings.
provisions.casual_quantifiable_loading: s 3B(3)(a): where an industrial instrument covering the employee specifies a casual loading that can be quantified, the base rate of pay including incentive-based payments, bonuses and the casual loading.
provisions.casual_otherwise: s 3B(3)(b): otherwise, the ordinary rate of pay including incentive-based payments and bonuses.
provisions.salary_sacrifice: s 3B(4)(a) and (aa): base rate of pay and ordinary rate of pay are read before amounts deducted under a salary sacrifice arrangement. The engine also applies s 3B(4)(b) to annual salary.
provisions.bonus_frequency: s 3B(4)(c) and (d) as implemented in assets/levy.mjs: incentive payments and bonuses count only where paid at least monthly.
